data.exact_reserve_text: The movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding, net of reinsurance recoveries is a favourable development of GBP 16.6m (2014: favourable development of GBP 10.9m); this comprises releases of GBP 16.0m in respect of direct Third Party Liability business, releases of GBP 0.3m in respect of direct Aviation business, GBP 0.2m in respect of total Reinsurance business and Other direct business releases of GBP 0.1m.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reports a net favourable prior-year development of GBP 16.6m (a release), driven primarily by releases on Third Party Liability business with smaller releases on Aviation, Reinsurance acceptances and Other direct business. A gross prior-year movement figure is not presented in the movement note (the movement is reported net of reinsurance recoveries), therefore the quantified movement used is the net release of GBP 16.6m. Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2015 (closing 2014 balance) was GBP 474.944m.

data.data_quality_notes: The 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' note reports a NET of reinsurance recoveries movement (GBP 16.6m favourable). No gross prior-year movement (insurance liabilities / gross) is provided in that note. The claims development triangle included in the report is explicitly net. Therefore prior_year_development_gbp_m uses the NET figure as a fallback (flagged). 'Other direct' LOB was mapped to 'Professional Lines' for the lob_movements section due to lack of a closer standard match; confidence on that mapping is low. Opening reserves taken from Balance Sheet 'Claims outstanding' (2014 comparative column).
